scope: Manual review of the original user-visible first-turn final answer, saved MATLAB metadata and actual eCOCO PNG; no private reasoning reviewed and no numerical science recalculated.

preset_assisted_execution.note: The original short user prompt, attachment and public skill/preset produced the six required MATLAB stages plus two additional phase-sensitivity stages. This is not blind method selection.

matlab_only_scientific_processing.note: Observed shell calls only read public preset/source files and saved MATLAB tables. No Python/numpy/awk numerical analysis, scientific replacement, parameter search, failed-stage retry or model-created transport projection occurred.

phase_sensitivity_scope.note: The model added trough tuning and original-proxy time diagnostics to assess reliability. These are not a separately validated third user turn.

scientific_interpretation.note: The final answer contains useful explicit limitations but also factual errors and overconfident inferences. Successful tools and image transport do not establish correctness of the narrative.

additional_limitations_to_state: The 5 kyr grid is an interpolation setting, not independent temporal resolution.
COCO/eCOCO Monte Carlo inference is conditional on the global LOWESS preprocessing; that nonlinear trend is not re-estimated for each null realization.
Actual client rendering/download is covered by separate Web acceptance receipts; this SDK report separately establishes tool artifacts, present events and model image transport.
